biography.value:
Description

A spirit that disguises itself as a beautiful woman. It favors strong-willed humans, devouring their souls for sustenance. As long as its victim's will is strong this spirit will attack both saints and villains indiscriminately. Apparently virtuous and evil emotions are equally nutritious when converted to energy. The more souls Ainsel consumes, the more powerful the spirit grows.

Defense

AC 27, touch 20, flat-footed 22 (+5 deflect, +5 dex, +7 natural)

hp 233 [310] (31d6+124)

mp 195

Fort +20, Ref +29, Will +27

Absorb fire, ice, lightning, wind;

DR 15/epic;

Immune critical hits, disable, death effects, gravity, poison, sneak attacks;

Weakness Earth

Offense

Speed 30 ft., swim 120 ft.

Melee Slam +15 (1d6 plus 2d8 [quarter fire/ice/lightning/wind damage]) or Touch +15 (1d4 Wis damage)

Special Attacks Malediction, Mesmerizing Voice

Spells Known (FC CL 31th, Concentration +36)

At will (DC 17) - bleed, detect magic, mending, message, read magic

1st (DC 18) - aero, blizzard, fire, sleep (DC 16), thunder

2nd (DC 19) - aero II, blizzard II, fire II, silence (DC 17), thunder II

3rd (DC 20) - aera, aero III, blizzara, blizzard III, fira, fire III, sleepga (DC 18), thundara, thunder III

4th (DC 21) - aero IV, blizzard IV, fire IV, silencega (DC 19), thunder IV

5th (DC 22) - aeroga, blizzaga, drain, firaga, freeze, shock, sleepja (DC 20), slice, thundaga

6th (DC 23) - burst, flare, glacier, greater vanish, silenceja (DC 21), tornado

7th (DC 24) - burn II, drainra, freeze II, shock II, slice II

8th (DC 25) - burst II, flare II, glacier II, tornado II

9th (DC 26) - death, drainga, iceburg, meteor, tsunami, winds of vengeance

Statistics

Str 10, Dex 20, Con 18, Int 24, Wis 16, Cha 20

Base Atk +15; CMB +15; CMD 29

Feats Alertness, Combat Casting, Dark Focus, Dark Penetration, Empower Spell, Greater Dark Focus, Greater Spell Focus (dark), Greater Spell Focus (element), Greater Spell Penetration, Intensified Spell, Maximize Spell, Silent Spell, Spell Penetration, Spell Focus (dark), Spell Focus (element), Quicken Spell

Skills Acrobatics +34, Bluff +35, Escape Artist +35, Knowledge (arcana) +36, Knowledge (local) +36, Knowledge (nature) +36, Perception +32, Sense Motive +32, Spellcraft +35, Stealth +35

Languages Aquan, Sylvan, Undercommon +5 others (DM's choice)

SQ Liquid Form

dr.custom: Liquid Form also grants DR 15/magic; do not stack reductions.

description.value: An ainsel is always in liquid form. She gains immunity to critical hits, poison, and sneak attacks. She also has DR/15 magic. She retains her own base speed, and her swim speed doubles to 120 feet.

Once every 1d4+1 rounds as a standard action, an ainsel can release malevolence from within draining the health of all nearby enemies within a 30-ft.-radius spread. An ainsel deals 12d6 points of shadow damage and is healed by half of the total damage done unless those in the area must make a Fortitude save (DC 32) to negate the heal affect and take half damage. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 9th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 33).
